Dear Basheer,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0484807.
Today I started with the update process of the charger. I already updated the charger form
v4 to v5
, and will proceed with the #3 subsequent firmware updates: v5 > v6 > v7 > v8.

In addition, I saw that on SCB the charger is marked to be located in Thailand for customer Evlomo:
I kindly ask you to update SCB page of the charger with the correct information.
I will provide you feedback on the FW update process soon.
